title: A Girl’s Story (FCP 2026)
synopsis: Annie Ernaux is invited to sign her latest book in the city of her childhood, Rouen. As she travels there, she is overcome with vertigo and is plunged back into her first night with a man. A night whose shockwave spread violently through her body and across the rest of her life...

synopsis_lang.en: Annie Ernaux is invited to sign her latest book in the city of her childhood, Rouen. As she travels there, she is overcome with vertigo and is plunged back into her first night with a man. A night whose shockwave spread violently through her body and across the rest of her life...
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: Annie Ernaux應邀回到她童年成長的城市魯昂，為新書簽名。前往途中，她突然感到恐慌，彷彿又回到首次與一名男子共渡的一夜。那一夜的衝擊猛烈地席捲她的身體，並蔓延至她往後的一生......

cast: Tess Barthélemy, Valérie Dréville, Maïwène Barthèlemy, Anja Verderosa
